statement: Between 2026-08-06 and 2026-09-30, US Central Command or the Department of Defense publicly confirms at least one new military strike on targets inside Iranian territory.
resolution: True if an official US military or DoD statement, carried by two or more major outlets, confirms a strike inside Iran occurring between 2026-08-06 and 2026-09-30.

statement: Front-month Brent crude futures settle above 100.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-06 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: True if ICE front-month Brent settlement exceeds 100.00 dollars on any session from 2026-08-06 through 2026-10-30, per exchange or major financial press data.

statement: NATO holds a formal Article 4 consultation at the request of a member state between 2026-08-06 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: True if NATO or a member government publicly confirms an Article 4 consultation held between 2026-08-06 and 2026-09-30. Routine North Atlantic Council statements do not resolve this true.

statement: The Nasdaq Composite closes below 22,485 on at least one trading day between 2026-08-06 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: True if the official Nasdaq Composite close is below 22,485 on any session from 2026-08-06 through 2026-11-30, per exchange or major financial press data.

statement: Public reporting attributes exploitation of Cisco CVE-2026-20316 to a specifically named nation-state actor or tracked threat group between 2026-08-06 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: True if a report from Cisco Talos, CISA, or a major security vendor published between 2026-08-06 and 2026-10-30 names a specific state actor or tracked group exploiting CVE-2026-20316.

statement: All commercial shipping transits of the Strait of Hormuz halt for at least 72 consecutive hours between 2026-08-06 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: True if Lloyds List, the IMO, or the US Navy publicly confirm zero commercial transits of the strait across 72 consecutive hours falling between 2026-08-06 and 2026-11-30.

statement: The Federal Open Market Committee announces a reduction in the federal funds target range at a scheduled meeting held between 2026-08-06 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: True if an FOMC statement issued between 2026-08-06 and 2026-10-30 announces a lower target range for the federal funds rate.

statement: The US Senate confirms Todd Blanche as Attorney General between 2026-08-06 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: True if the Senate record shows a successful confirmation vote seating Todd Blanche as Attorney General between 2026-08-06 and 2026-10-30.

statement: The confirmed death toll from the magnitude 6.8 Uto, Japan earthquake reaches 50 or more between 2026-08-06 and 2026-08-31.
resolution: True if Japanese government or major wire reporting between 2026-08-06 and 2026-08-31 states a confirmed death toll of at least 50 from that earthquake.

statement: A single attack in Pakistan kills at least 10 police or military personnel between 2026-08-06 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: True if credible international reporting confirms one attack in Pakistan between 2026-08-06 and 2026-10-30 killing 10 or more police or military personnel.
